_doc: Player-facing changelog for Tumblefair, newest first (shared/whats-new.js reads it). Append one entry at EVERY publish: plain language, what players will notice, no file names. `id` is stable and unique (date, plus a letter for a second publish that day).

entries.title: Expansion: The Fair Comes Alive
items: 🤖 Computer fairgoers (optional): the host can fill empty seats with computer players (Family, Normal or Tricky). They play every minigame and step aside when a friend joins. A "Rival when alone" switch turns solo opponents on or off.
⚡ Quick Match: a full board game in about ten minutes, with one tap. Every lobby choice now says about how long it takes, and a clock under the scores shows how far through you are.
🔁 Play again on the final screen starts a rematch with the same players, and a highlight reel shows the night's biggest win, closest finish and luckiest spin.
📖 New mode, Story Night: five fairground adventures where your choices and minigame wins change the story, ending with a Hero of the Night.
🎟️ The Fair Pass: earn stickers, level up, unlock costumes and name colours, and take on a new daily challenge every day.
🎮 Try before it counts: while the rules are up you can already play. Nothing counts until you tap I'm ready. Every game now explains itself in one line with pictures of its buttons.
⚙️ Comfort settings: bigger text, less motion, and Relaxed timers for the host.

🎪 10 new games: Bouncy Castle, Seesaw Shove, Candy Floss Frenzy, Big Ball Bop, Funhouse Mirrors, Mystic Fortunes, Tip the Scales, Merry-Go-Guess, and two team bosses: the Wind-Up Bear and the Balloon Baron.
🔧 16 games rebuilt from your ratings, including Defuse Together, Meteor Dash, Tiptoe Tiger, Safecracker, Laser Limbo, Firefly Catch and Mini Golf.
⚖️ Fairer starts in seven games, no peeking at hidden answers in three, and tougher team games on Normal and Tricky.
❄️ Coming December 1: the Winter Fair, with a snowy board, 8 winter games (including the Frost Giant boss), winter versions of favourites and 12 winter costumes.

entries.title: Chat, catch-up and nine game fixes
items: Chat with the room: tap 💬 under the menu button for quick reactions or a short message, and everyone sees it pop up.
A little help for whoever's last: from round 2, the player furthest behind gets 3 catch-up tickets.
If someone's phone leaves the game, they're shown as away and their turns are played for them; after 2 minutes they leave the board.
Opening the game in a second window now moves you there instead of making a copy, and two characters no longer stand inside each other in the lobby.
The Wheel of Whatever is much bigger on phones.
Letter Shot: the hoop is no longer hidden behind the scores on phones.
Court Clash: the computer player is a step slower, waits a moment before going for the ball, and can't steal it while you're winding up a shot.
Dirt Dash: a gauge warns you before you flip over, a ring turns green when it's safe to land, and you can watch your flips count up.
Slime Slingers: getting slimed while dodging no longer leaves you stuck for the rest of the game.
Pumpkin Fling: the power bar and arm move about half as fast, the button tells you which tap is next, and taps work on iPhone. Long Drive's swing button works reliably on iPhone too.
Coffin Cart Rally: arrows on the floor show the way round, and a big WRONG WAY sign appears if you drive backwards.
Costume Catwalk: everyone dresses up and walks the runway as their own character.
Castle Archers: drag back and up to shoot straight down at goblins bashing the gate.

entries.title: New character bodies
items: Characters are taller, with longer legs and real shoulders, while keeping their cartoon faces.
Shoulders are smooth and round, the upper arm no longer disappears under short sleeves, and legs join cleanly at the knee.
Hands are plain fists, without the two lines across them.

entries.title: Golf mode: Mini golf and Fairway
items: Golf mode now asks which course: ⛳ Mini golf or 🏌️ Fairway — and how many holes: 3, 6, 9 or a full 18.

Mini golf: an 18-hole course where half the holes are shaped like letters and numbers (L, U, S, Z, 2, 3, 7, O, a figure 8) and the rest are wild designs — a spiral, an island green, a windmill, a spinner gauntlet.

Fairway: 18 real-looking holes with tee shots, fairways, rough, bunkers, water and sloping greens. Pick your club, read the wind, swing with the power and accuracy meter, and go for a hole in one on the par 3s.
Fewest strokes over the whole round wins, with a full scorecard. Golf mode is always Halloween-free.

entries.title: Host on your TV
items: Spectate → Host on this screen: your TV shows a big QR code and the room code, everyone joins on their phones, and the TV just watches.
The first player to join sets up and starts the game from their phone (or untick that to set it up on the TV with a controller). The room stays open between games.
Watching an arena game? Pick All or follow one player at the bottom of the screen.

entries.title: Lock your phone, keep your seat
items: Locking your phone or switching apps mid-game no longer drops you: you're back in the same room, seat and score when you return (for up to 5 minutes).

entries.title: 42 new minigames and a livelier board
items: 42 new minigames, including: basketball (Hoop Frenzy, Court Clash, Letter Shot), Dirt Dash, Wizard Duel, Tower Pull, Castle Archers, Fair Darts, Pizza Pronto, Wagon Trail, Hide & Peek, Tilt & Lance, Floor Is Lava, Flood Rush, Claw Machine, Steady Hand, Shell Shuffle, Monster Rampage and Night of the Shamblers.
10 new Halloween games (October only), built on your favourites — Patchwork Pal, Cauldron Bobbing, Shifty Portraits, Pumpkin Fling, Coffin Cart Rally and more.
Fair games: Bumper Boats, Downhill Derby, Pie Toss, Ring Toss, Balloon Darts, Duck Derby, Water Balloon Ambush, Photo Booth and Sketchy Copy.
More memory games: Carousel Recall, Gone Missing!, Pair Panic and Order Up!

The board game: live events everyone plays — a real Dice Duel, High Striker, Shell Game, Steal or Share, Tomato Toss, Fortune Teller — plus prize cards, a shortcut toll, a cannon and quicker turns. The scores and results no longer cover the board.
Your favourite games got more variety (new rinks, tracks, themes and pictures), and the least-liked ones were rebuilt to be simpler.
✨ New and 🔧 Updated tags show which games just arrived or changed.
Screens are tidier on phones: name tags don't pile up, the connection dot moved into the ☰ menu, and the odd one out is always visible.
What's new: this list!

entries.title: New ways to play: Custom, Golf, and first to 100
items: Custom mode: no board and no vote — the host picks every minigame from the list and finishes whenever you like.
Golf mode: a round of golf, one hole after another.
Board games can be "First to 60 / 100 / 150 / 200 tickets" instead of a set number of rounds (a ribbon counts as 10).
Halloween mode: tick the box in the lobby to play only Halloween games. Unticked, they're mixed in while it's October.
One card in every vote is a ⭐ Top rated game, picked from everyone's 👍. The host can favour funny, competitive, teamwork, skill or relaxing games.
New 👍/👎 reasons that say what kind of fun it was, or what went wrong.
Filter the minigame list by kind: memory, racing, golf, fishing, boss fights and more.
Vote to remove a player, and the host's remove now keeps them out.
More time to read the rules: the game starts as soon as everyone taps "I'm ready".
My games: every minigame you've played, how many times, and what you thought of it.
Fixes: a clearer Long Drive, step-by-step Secret Architect, Two Truths now uses real facts, a fairer Safecracker, and the results screen says what each number means.
A tidier title screen.

entries.title: Accounts and fishing
items: Sign in (optional) to keep your coins, costumes and look on every phone — one account for every game on games.radgh.com. Scan a QR code to sign in with your phone.
Four fishing games: Reel Rumble, Pier Pressure, Net Gains and Glimmer Ice.

entries.title: Controllers, move cards and a tougher golem
items: Walk every menu with a game controller.
Move cards: hold 4 cards instead of rolling the die, or steal a mystery card from a rival.
Lobbies wait 5 minutes for a phone that fell asleep.
Pick clothes from a list in Change look.
Golem Smash: little rock critters to stomp, and a jump.

entries.title: Boss fights, ratings and Halloween
items: 20 new minigames, including co-op boss fights.
Rate every minigame 👍 or 👎 — it helps us make the fair better.
Public games: find a game to join from the title screen.
Halloween: spooky minigames, costumes and a haunted board all October.
The ☰ menu, Just watch, and Play instead.

entries.title: Dozens of new minigames and the Moonlit Pier
items: Over 50 minigames: races, brawls, boxing, dress-up and more.
A second board: the Moonlit Pier.
Smoother online play.
